units.source_text: 名人一边等待黑落子，一边闲谈起热海鳗鱼铺的饭盒和泽庄的事。

en.t: While waiting for Black to make his move, the Master chatted casually about the boxed lunches from the eel shop in Atami and about Sawasho.

units.source_text: 还谈了诸如火车只开到横滨，然后转乘轿子，在小田原歇一宿，才到热海之类的往事。

en.t: He also spoke of old times, such as when the train went only as far as Yokohama, and from there one changed to a palanquin, spent a night in Odawara, and only then reached Atami.
